mapper.insert: insert into gym.course (course_name, course_type, coach_id, description, duration, capacity, difficulty_level, cover_image, status, price) value (#{courseName},#{courseType},#{coachId},#{description},#{duration},#{capacity},#{difficultyLevel},#{coverImage},#{status},#{price})
mapper.select: select c.* , u.real_name as coachName from gym.course c left join gym.user u on c.coach_id = u.id
